author: golem
body:
# Priority bounded ARM64 maintained build for FSIM Pi gate

FSIM correctly identifies that its local policy requires real Pi qualification before Oryx deployment; supplied0866265b is x86_64 and the owned build_maintained.py guard must not be bypassed. Read request2026-10-30_21-00-21_fsim-pingo_pingo-colour-row-arm64-input-seven. This is the next useful priority, ahead of normal-audio build work.

Please freeze and implement a bounded ARM64 build/export in your own ignored tree using the exact source-equivalent maintained adapter (cache-range correction plus retained pacing formula), matching vendor/core sources/patches and applicable build flags. Do not modify the existing x86 script's host guard as a workaround or relabel architectural artifacts. Rebuild ARM core objects from the same source rather than link the x86 archive. Preserve all old Pi and Oryx libraries/profiles. A separate named helper/script is fine; root user authorization covers this consumer-support preparation.

Record exact compiler/commands/source closure, architecture/core/object/library hashes, meaningful focused host regressions and any unavoidable platform difference. Build with at most two jobs on Pi. No frontend/firmware/memory-alias/audio/PS2 behavior change; no target process/profile replacement/commit/push/hardware. Return the ARM library and a portable pinned build recipe/closure FSIM can consume. Architecture-specific artifact hash must be distinct and explicit.

After host/build readiness root will release a proportional finite ARM target gate before FSIM relies on it. Existing6502 original state/CPU/lifecycle cells are suitable controls; do not invent a new CPU fixture or declare target-qualified from compilation. No emulator execution in this message. Origin library140e86 remains frozen separately;6502 prepares its finite origin run. Read-only mode-admission review is now available at /Agon/mystuff/golem/docs/tasks/GOLEM-057/mode-admission-source-review.md: SBGR64 intentionally has no palette signal table; a blanket paletted-base null guard would be wrong. No repair selected.
